summary: Groups are always created, permission templates can be imported by script, and the Pro edition is introduced.

new.title: Groups are always created
new.text: A permission group is created even when its workload is not ready. Only a new workload role assignment waits until that workload's prerequisites are green, and the GUI shows where.
new.action: Run the workload prerequisite script once for Intune, Defender XDR and Power BI, or their new role assignments wait.

new.title: Import permission templates by script
new.text: You can import template packs into one or many environments by script. It adds only what is missing, reuses existing groups and takes a snapshot first.

new.title: The Pro edition
new.text: Single-tenant essentials stay free. Coverage & gaps, extra connectors, Access reviews, managing and managed tenants and more need a Pro licence; Settings > Licence shows your status.
new.action: If you use managed tenants or any Pro feature, install your Pro licence before upgrading.

new.title: Microsoft Sentinel option
new.text: The workload prerequisite script can now enable Microsoft Sentinel on a dedicated, empty security workspace, if you choose.

fixes.title: Defender XDR role assignments fixed
fixes.text: Defender XDR role assignments now include what Microsoft requires, and new custom roles are found correctly after creation.
